topStories.headline: Alphabet Q2 Revenue Beats at $119.8B but Stock Sinks on $200B Capex Guidance Hike
topStories.summary: Alphabet reported Q2 revenue of $119.8B (+24% YoY) and EPS of $9.11, but raised full-year capex guidance to $195–$205B from $180–$190B, reigniting concerns about AI spending payoff.
topStories.marketImpact: GOOGL ↓ after-hours; AI capex-vs-payoff narrative intensifies across the sector; Cloud peers under pressure ↓

topStories.headline: Equifax Tumbles Up to 12% as Weak Forward Guidance Overshadows Earnings Beat
topStories.summary: EFX guided Q3 EPS of $2.15–$2.25 and full-year revenue of $6.71B–$6.78B, well below the $7.39B Wall Street consensus, despite Q2 revenue of $1.70B (+11%) beating expectations.
topStories.marketImpact: EFX ↓ 7–12%; inflation pressuring lower-income consumer credit data demand; net income fell 4% YoY despite revenue growth

topStories.headline: Oil Tops $85 as Houthis Threaten to Open Second Shipping Chokepoint at Bab al-Mandeb
topStories.summary: WTI crude surpassed $85/bbl for the first time since June as Houthi rebels threatened a blockade of the Bab al-Mandeb strait, potentially adding a second chokepoint to the Strait of Hormuz already disrupted by the Iran war.
topStories.marketImpact: Oil ↑; Gold ↑ above $4,100/oz; inflation fears resurface; airlines and consumer discretionary watch ↓; energy sector ↑

topStories.headline: China's National Team Rescues STAR 50 With Massive ETF Buys — Index Surges 11% in Single Session
topStories.summary: Chinese state funds bought the ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF aggressively, sending the semiconductor-heavy index to its biggest single-session gain in 21 months; the CSI 300 chip sub-index surged 12.2%.
topStories.marketImpact: CSI 300 ↑ +3% at 4,739; Chinese tech and semi stocks ↑; interpreted as official confidence signal ahead of CXMT's July 27 IPO

topStories.headline: CXMT Confirms July 27 STAR Market Listing — Asia's Biggest IPO of 2026 at $85B Valuation
topStories.summary: Memory chipmaker ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) confirmed its debut on Shanghai's STAR Market for July 27 after a 212x-oversubscribed IPO raised $8.6B; CXMT holds ~7.7% of global DRAM market share.
topStories.marketImpact: MU ↓ on competitive pressure; Samsung (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) face state-backed rival; Chinese semi sector ↑

topStories.headline: Japan June Trade Deficit Surges to ¥407B as Iran War Inflates Import Costs Far Beyond Forecasts
topStories.summary: Japan posted a ¥406.9B ($2.5B) trade deficit in June — far exceeding the ¥120B forecast — as exports rose 19% but imports surged 25%, driven by yen weakness and Iran war-elevated energy prices.
topStories.marketImpact: JPY under further pressure ↓; energy-intensive manufacturers watch ↓; export firms benefit from weak yen ↑ but face rising input costs; 7203.T (Toyota) mixed

topStories.headline: TSMC Q2 Profit Surges 77%, Raises Arizona Investment to $100B as AI Demand Accelerates
topStories.summary: TSMC reported Q2 revenue of $40.2B (+36% YoY) with net profit up 77.4%; high-performance computing now accounts for 66% of revenue; company raised 2026 capex to $60B and committed an additional $100B to Arizona.
topStories.marketImpact: TSM ↑; AI semiconductor demand confirmed robust; NVDA, AMD, AVGO benefit from continued foundry expansion and investment commitment

topStories.headline: Meta, Microsoft, Amazon Earnings This Week Put AI Capex Justification Under the Microscope
topStories.summary: After Alphabet's capex-driven selloff, markets brace for Meta and Microsoft earnings on July 29 and Amazon on July 30, with AI infrastructure spending versus revenue return the central question for all three.
topStories.marketImpact: META ↓ approaching $600 on AI cost concerns going in; AMZN ↑ on AWS growth upgraded to 33% by BofA; MSFT watch for cloud capex guidance

topStories.headline: Gold Climbs Above $4,100 as Bitcoin Retreats from Monthly High on Oil-Driven Inflation Fears
topStories.summary: Gold surged above $4,100/oz as Iran war disruptions and surging oil prices boosted safe-haven demand, while Bitcoin slipped ~1% to ~$65,900 after touching a one-month high the prior session.
topStories.marketImpact: GLD ↑; precious metals outperform; BTC ↓ ~1% to ~$65,900; ETH ↓ 0.5% to ~$1,920; risk appetite cautious
